name: @titanforge/dev-server
description: Dev server with HMR: esbuild-powered on-the-fly transform of route/component files, an fs.watch file watcher, and a WebSocket channel that pushes update messages to a minimal client-side HMR runtime. Scope: re-renders the affected route on change; component-local state is not preserved across a swap (no fiber-level patching like React Fast Refresh).
